biggest_catch: Offer ends September 30, 2026 — 7 days from verification (2026-09-23). To earn the bonus you must complete 30 Visa debit card purchases of at least $5 each within 90 days, and the checking account must stay open 12 months or the bonus is debited back at closing.
catches: Enter promo code NEWCHK26 when applying online (or mention it in person).
Within the first 90 days: (1) open and deposit $20 into a new checking account, (2) make at least 30 Visa debit card transactions of $5+ each, (3) sign up for electronic statements.
Cash bonus of $200 is deposited in the member's savings account within 10 business days after all qualifications are met.
Not valid on business accounts; not available to existing members, fiduciary accounts, anyone who closed an account within 60 months, or members with a negative balance.
Checking account must remain open for a minimum of 12 months or the bonus will be debited from the account at closing (12-month clawback).
Cannot be combined with other checking offers or add-on bonus offers (including the FRIEND26 referral tier or the BDCHECK26 preferred-partner tier).
Membership eligibility: open to everyone who lives, works, worships, or attends school in Franklin, Licking, Fairfield, Pickaway, Madison, Union, Delaware, or Morrow County (Central Ohio).
Cash bonus may be considered income and reported on 1099-MISC or 1099-INT — taxable.

steps: Confirm BMI FCU membership eligibility (live, work, worship, or attend school in the 8 listed Central Ohio counties).
Apply for a new BMI FCU Free Checking account, entering promo code NEWCHK26 (or mention it in person).
Deposit at least $20 into the new checking account.
Within the first 90 days, make at least 30 Visa debit card transactions of $5 or more each.
The $200 bonus is deposited into your savings account within 10 business days of meeting all qualifications; keep the checking account open 12 months to avoid the bonus being debited back.
